edges.notes: C/C++ toolchains targeting Wasm link wasi-libc-built objects into Wasm modules.
Many compilers target wasm32 via LLVM; LLVM includes an in-tree WebAssembly code generation target.
Browser engine stacks commonly pair Wasm modules with WebGPU for portable GPU-accelerated workloads.
Wasm + JS engine stacks commonly pair WebAssembly modules with WebGL contexts for legacy portable graphics.
